title: No on-chain invariant couples Uniboost.donationSplit and UniboostMintDebtHook.ratio (cross-contract decoupling) -- Uniboost instance of L-05
description: The Uniboost donationSplit and the UniboostMintDebtHook.ratio are set on two different contracts with no on-chain coupling invariant. Same root-cause class as OPEN ledger L-05 (BalancerPoolerV2 batchDonationSize <-> Hook.ratio). Second observed instance on the new Uniboost dispatcher + hook pair.
impact: No solvency break. ratio is hard-capped at MAX_RATIO=50, so worst-case accrued debt is <=50% of dispatched prime while retained value is ~100% at dispatch => backing buffer holds (Tier-3 confirms >=2:1). Edge cases 0%/100% verified SAFE. Impact is a transparency/config-coupling gap, not a value-at-risk path.
attackPath: 1. Owner sets donationSplit and hook.ratio independently across two contracts.
2. No invariant ties them; a mismatched pair is silently accepted.
3. Worst case: <=50% debt vs ~100% retained value -> still over-backed (no break).
recommendation: Same as L-05: introduce an on-chain coupling guardrail tying donationSplit and hook.ratio (e.g. donationSplit + ratio bound).
dedupNote: Same class as open L-05. Reuses L-05 fingerprint (e527a712) as a second instance; NOT a regression (L-05 is open, not fixed). Annotate L-05 with the Uniboost mirror.
